ruleName: "equals(Object obj)" and "hashCode()" should be overridden in pairs

classificationSoundnessExplanation: The abstract clone() method in NSObject.java forces subclasses to implement clone(), and the subclasses implement clone() properly by instanciating a new object and setting all relevant fields, rather than the problematic Object.clone() approach. The method could be renamed to something else, instead of overwriting clone(), but that doesn't add any value. (However, TP would be sound here too)
